answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Each submission hangs on the lagoon of a task receipt, and the vault is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. What survives to the crystal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
